title.zh: 窃取Uranium Finance近5500万美元黑客被判有罪，面临最高20年监禁
title.en: 窃取Uranium Finance近5500万美元黑客被判有罪，面临最高20年监禁

current_state.zh: A New York jury found cybersecurity consultant Jonathan Spalletta guilty of stealing roughly $55 million from the Uranium Finance crypto platform in 2021 and laundering the proceeds through mixers like Tornado Cash, leaving him facing up to 20 years in prison at a Feb. 16 sentencing.
